recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is and do not remove amended from core DiagnosticReport for FHIR-5692. Revisit only through a new OO/Vocabulary decision if current-release status hierarchy or definitions are reopened.
issue_request: FHIR-5692 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 OO request to remove DiagnosticReport.status code amended as a US Realm concept overlapping corrected, and to create a US Realm extension only once a definition existed. Its comments add that LRI/FR guide work decided amended was not needed for OBR.25, so no DiagnosticReport extension was needed for that concept.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5692 was found in the relevant DiagnosticReport/status history. Current active DiagnosticReport source still contains amended, corrected, and appended in the DiagnosticReport status CodeSystem and the required DiagnosticReport.status binding, so the original removal request was not literally applied as a durable removal in current core source.
additional_context: Later final OO decisions supersede a literal removal. FHIR-10436 and FHIR-10344 aligned DiagnosticReport.status and Observation.status while retaining distinct sets. FHIR-32986 rejected changing the post-final DiagnosticReport status definitions and added modified for pre-final changes. FHIR-41241 added DiagnosticReport.relatesTo for relationships among reports that are replaced, amended, extended, or otherwise related. Related issues FHIR-32986, FHIR-41241, and FHIR-33042 already have reconcile commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Removing amended now would conflict with later applied/published OO decisions and with current active source. Creating a US Realm extension is not supported by FHIR-5692's own comments or later core work on report relationships.
